verdict.rationale: Mastercard's official GitHub repo, open-banking-us-openapi, ships an API specification that its test project uses to generate a client library, which points to a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI spec. The MCP toolkit docs also reference generating code from current API specifications. missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing where to download the spec and its format/version, independent or hands-on confirmation of the spec's completeness and currency.
